verdict.rationale: Codex CLI and cloud/web interfaces are natural-language driven: users type prompts to explore code, plan changes, edit files, run commands, and delegate tasks, with the agent interpreting intent rather than requiring rigid syntax (codex-docs-8, codex-docs-9, codex-docs-6, codex-docs-13). Community evidence corroborates real-world natural-language agentic use, though with mixed quality feedback on execution. missing for 10: independent benchmarking specifically on NL command comprehension/robustness, and more consistent hands-on praise (some reports call it inconsistent or requiring extra prompting, e.g. codex-comm-3, codex-comm-15).
